item.title: How to Give Claude Code a Real Browser: Headful Chromium in Docker with Playwright MCP
item.description: Run a headful Chromium in Docker on your dev VM so Claude Code can browse, shop and screenshot sites with no laptop on, and watch it over VNC from a phone.

item.title: How I Turned My Laptop Into a Dumb Terminal With a Tailscale Dev VM, T3 Code, and Claude Code
item.description: A persistent dev VM over Tailscale, running T3 Code and Claude Code, turns any laptop into a thin client - and why I'm stripping Windows down instead of buying a beefier laptop.

item.title: Give Claude Code Eyes Inside Your WSL2 Docker Containers
item.description: Stop copy-pasting Docker Compose logs into Claude Code. Set up SSH access into WSL2 so Claude can read your container logs directly - the same trick that powers a pentest workflow with a Kali VM.
